    n=len(g); flat=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            orb={(i,j),(i,n-1-j),(n-1-i,j),(n-1-i,n-1-j)}
            vals=[g[a][b] for a,b in orb]
            c=Counter(vals)
            top=max(c.values()); cands=[v for v,k in c.items() if k==top]
